comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
Hi @mlanighan we don't create release teams without at least one release repository that team maintains.

Can you please update this request to include at least one release repository. If it helps you can refer to the [new release team template](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/blob/latest/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new_release_team.md) for the requested information.

comments.author: mlanighan
comments.body: Hi @nuclearsandwich we are trying to release [trac_ik](https://bitbucket.org/traclabs/trac_ik/src/rolling-devel/) to rolling. We have an open [PR](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/39986) to add it to rosdistro.
